description: Implementation of NetworkManager plugin for RDK, including network monitoring, WiFi signal quality measurement, connectivity checks, and configuration management.

classes.name: NetworkManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implementation class for network management, including connectivity, WiFi, and IP monitoring.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Loads configuration parameters from a string.

methods.name: GetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves current STUN server endpoint and related parameters.

methods.name: SetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the STUN server endpoint and parameters.

methods.name: GetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves current connectivity test endpoints.

methods.name: SetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Sets connectivity test endpoints.

methods.name: IsConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity status and returns IP version and interface.

methods.name: GetCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Retrieves URI for captive portal detection.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Gets the active primary network interface.

methods.name: GetPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves the public IP address via STUN.

methods.name: SetLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the plugin's log level.

methods.name: GetLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs a ping to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Performs a traceroute to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: executeExternally
methods.description: Executes a network command and processes the output.

methods.name: filterScanResults
methods.description: Filters WiFi scan results based on SSID list and frequency.

methods.name: GetSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Returns supported WiFi security modes.

methods.name: ReportInterfaceStateChange
methods.description: Reports changes in network interface state.

methods.name: ReportActiveInterfaceChange
methods.description: Reports change in active network interface.

methods.name: ReportIPAddressChange
methods.description: Reports change in IP address for an interface.

methods.name: ReportInternetStatusChange
methods.description: Reports change in internet connectivity status.

methods.name: logSSIDs
methods.description: Logs WiFi SSID list at specified log level.

methods.name: ReportAvailableSSIDs
methods.description: Reports available WiFi SSIDs after scanning and filtering.

methods.name: startWiFiSignalQualityMonitor
methods.description: Starts WiFi signal quality monitoring thread.

methods.name: stopWiFiSignalQualityMonitor
methods.description: Stops WiFi signal quality monitoring thread.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Retrieves current WiFi signal quality metrics.

methods.name: processMonitor
methods.description: Monitors process memory usage periodically.

methods.name: monitorThreadFunction
methods.description: Thread function for WiFi signal quality monitoring.

methods.name: ReportWiFiStateChange
methods.description: Reports WiFi state changes.

methods.name: ReportWiFiSignalQualityChange
methods.description: Reports WiFi signal quality changes.
